verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Cline syncing or resuming a task across devices or browsers. The closest items are different features: history carrying over between Plan and Act modes, a web-based Kanban board for parallel agents, scheduled agents that survive process restarts, and chat from Slack, Discord or Telegram. None of these documents continuing the same task from another device.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start a task on one device and continue it later from another device or browser
